newsitem.title: USA: NYPA shuts NY-Quebec power line for maintenance.
newsitem.headline: NYPA shuts NY-Quebec power line for maintenance.

text.p: The New York Power Authority (NYPA) said Thursday it will begin shutting two portions of a 765 kilovolt (KV) transmission line that runs between Quebec and central New York for seasonal maintenance.
The entire line has the capability of carry 2,350 megawatts (MW), a company spokeswoman said.
A segment from Quebec to Massena in northern New York will be idled Friday, and the second section from Massena to Marcy, N.Y., will be taken out of service Saturday, she said.
"They will be re-energized November 8," she said.
NYPA shuts the line segments every year after the summer peak demand season. "We do that every year for preventiive annual maintenance," she said.
